title: GT5 Reimagined
description: A Reimagining of GT5U for modern minecraft versions
body:
GT5 Reimagined is a Reimagining of GregTech 5U for modern Minecraft versions

Original GregTech 5 description:

 

GregTech, created by GregoriusT, is a Mod that completely overhauls Minecraft, adding numerous Machines and Materials, as well as adjusting Recipes for existing Items in order to make them fit with its System. GregTech is meant to extend the Game by making things much less overpowered, more reasonable, and adding a lot of complex machines, as well as generally useful utility.

 

This project takes this onto modern Minecraft versions whilst improving many frankly stupid things gt5u did and integrating some changes from gt6 as well as integrating the new mc features as best as possible.
